description: Google Flights results as JSON from your agent: a local bridge to the hosted HasData Google Flights MCP service that searches one-way, round-trip and multi-city itineraries with passenger mix, travel class, stops, airline and emissions filters, returning per-itinerary prices, durations, legs and tokens as returned upstream. One bin serves a small CLI and a stdio MCP server.
name: @reneturcios/flightdata
